why: A refit, after the features moved twice under the committed policies: models/clone/ci-69 was trained under features:v5 and the engine reads features:v8, so every turn since has failed at its baseline step, refused by AgentFactory before a match was played (ci-240). This turn asks one thing: what a clone of the strongest one-step player fits to on content e6f72578 under ADR 0096 and 0098. The teacher is search-23, which takes 0.997 from Greedy on the benchmark seeds and is the newest set the weight ladder kept. The lookahead on lookahead-34 is stronger, but it records a self-play match in about six seconds on four cores, so three datasets of the usual size would take some 25 hours against the 300-minute limit, and a few hundred matches a seed is too thin to fit on. The baseline is the teacher itself, so evaluation-vs-baseline reads how close the clone comes to what it imitates. The champion bar cannot be read: ci-69 cannot be played under features:v8, which the gate already reads as cannot be compared. The first try of this turn (ci-245) measured what search-23 costs here: its self-play matches run long, so 5000 of them took 47 minutes to record, the exploring dataset another 46, and the runner was shut down two minutes into the first fit, with two seeds still to record. So this turn records 2000 matches a seed and no exploring dataset, about 19 minutes a seed; the value policy fits on the pure dataset, as it does whenever a turn records no exploring one. Expected before the run: a clone near parity with its teacher and well above Greedy, as every clone of a heuristic has landed; a clone that falls well short of search-23 says the features lost something the scorer reads, which is the finding.
